function: Learned joint design of BS downlink beamforming, BS uplink combining, UL user power, and STAR-RIS amplitudes and phases to maximize weighted UL+DL total rate (p. 1, 3).
system: Full-duplex BS (4 antennas), 2 simultaneously transmitting and reflecting RISs (20 elements each), 3 DL and 3 UL single-antenna users; band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: Meta DDPG: actor-critic deep reinforcement learning (DDPG) plus a meta-learning bi-level loss on the actor; reward is the total rate when constraints C1-C3 hold (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: path loss -35.6-37.5log10(x) dB (exponent 3.75), Rayleigh direct links, Rician (factor 4) RIS links, Gaussian residual self-interference; no standardized or measured data (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Trained with Rayleigh direct and Rician RIS links; for the generalization test, direct links switch to Rician fading; identical train/test case also reported (p. 4).
baselines: Learned: conventional DDPG (different and identical train/test data); variants: Meta DDPG with identical data, Meta DDPG with ordinary RIS instead of STAR-RIS; no non-learned method (p. 4).
metrics: System total rate (STR, weighted UL+DL finite-blocklength rate), convergence, and UL versus DL total-rate trade-off, with sweeps over number of RISs, BS power, self-interference (p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "the small-scale fading in the direct channels between the BS, UL and DL users follow Rayleigh fading, while the channels between RISs, UL and DL users exhibit Rician fading". Custom simulator; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "the Meta DDPG and DDPG algorithms are testes using a scenario where all direct channels between the BS, UL, and DL users experience Rician fading", whereas training uses "Rayleigh fading for all direct channels".
q3_support: p. 4: "Baseline 1: conventional DDPG with different training and testing data" is a learned baseline, but the other baselines are Meta DDPG variants. Missing: any non-learned method (random or fixed RIS, optimization) in the results.
q4_support: p. 2: "the iterative optimization-based methods to obtain sub-optimal solutions have high computation complexity" is qualitative and about other methods; p. 4: "Meta DDPG exhibits faster convergence than conventional DDPG". Missing: complexity order, parameters, or runtime of Meta DDPG.
q5_support: p. 4: "the BS is equipped with N = 4 antennas and positioned at coordinates (0, 0)" shows the own simulated setup. Missing: any code or data link, public dataset, or measurement.
notes: Area 3: joint BS beamforming and combining, UL power, and STAR-RIS configuration. The training scenario of the different-data case is inferred from the identical-data case (Rayleigh direct links); only the Rician test scenario is stated (p. 4). On p. 5 the text says close to baseline 1 where baseline 2 seems meant.
